# LocalTC

> LocalTC is free, open-source voice air traffic control (ATC) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024 on Windows. It runs on the user's own PC and works offline, with an AI copilot, a voice-controlled ground crew (GSX supported) and a cabin crew. No subscription, account or usage limit. License: GNU AGPL v3.

- Controllers from clearance delivery to the gate: SIDs, STARs, vectors, approaches, go-arounds, real traffic on the frequency, FAA and ICAO phraseology, checked readbacks.
- Local by default: Whisper speech recognition, Piper voices, an Ollama language model. Optional cloud model with the user's own free key.
- Copilot, ground crew and cabin crew in English and ten other languages.
- Companion iPhone app, live web tracker, logbook with replays.
